item.title: Indonesia Begins Trimming Pipeline Gas Exports to Singapore
item.description: Indonesia reduced natural gas exports to neighboring Singapore from Saturday as President Prabowo Subianto seeks to shore up domestic supply and strengthen energy security for Southeast Asia’s largest economy.

item.title: Singapore Expands Haze Inquiries to 10 Locally Based Firms
item.description: Singapore expanded its investigation into haze-creating fires in Indonesia that have blanketed the city-state in smog, requesting information from 10 locally registered companies.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Suggests Riyadh Airport May Reopen on Sunday
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s main airport was gearing up to reopen as early as Sunday after operations had been disrupted by a spate of attacks by Houthi rebels.

item.title: Embracing the Bond Market: Masters in Business with Robin Wigglesworth
item.description: Barry speaks with Robin Wigglesworth, editor of Financial Times' Alphaville blog and author of the new book 'A Fabulous Debt: The Epic Story of How Bonds Built the Modern World'. They discuss the bond market as the engine of the global economy, why the 30-year mortgage is "a miracle of the modern world," and when we should actually start worrying about US debt. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: French Protesters Dispersed with Gas as Tensions Rise
item.description: Student protesters in Paris, France were dispersed with gas as conflict escalates. (Source: Bloomberg)
